knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Identification sets the scope and the approved method.
Without identification, the cleaning is limited to the safest approved scope.
Electrical controls are not cleaned with liquid.

practicalCriteria: Records appliance type, make and model from a sample label.
Marks in-scope and excluded parts for a sample appliance.
Escalates a simulated unidentified appliance and cleans only the exterior.
passRule: Identification recorded, scope marked, and unidentified appliance escalated without guessing. Observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Scope marking on the job record
stopWorkCriteria: Liquid applied to controls or openings
Unidentified appliance cleaned with an unknown method
